definitions: A collection of Vue components, composables, and utilities built on top of Nuxt.js, designed to provide a robust and customizable user interface for web applications.
A module for Nuxt.js that offers a set of pre-built and styled UI components, often used for rapid development of web interfaces.
examples: We are building our new dashboard with Nuxt UI.
The developer chose Nuxt UI for its extensive component library.
Learning Nuxt UI can significantly speed up front-end development.
